routes.description: Corpus, reading stages and typed relation counts
Available record filters and counts in the chosen paper scope
Record, typed links and aligned paper passages
Paged links for a global or paper graph
Explain one recorded connection within a bounded traversal
Scoped dependency view, components and condensation
Passage, section, text selection or node correspondence
Authored reading routes and shared-claim alternatives for a passage or section
Resolve a declared companion document identity without verifying fragments
Literal search of records, headings and passages

paper_scope.meaning: Authored focus; mentioned claims and retained prerequisites may extend beyond these goals.

lean.full_support.scope: Recorded classification and bound evidence only; no execution authentication or mathematical acceptance.

lean.value_consequences.scope: Recorded classification and bound evidence only; no execution authentication or mathematical acceptance.

scalar.lean_gaussian_target.scope: Recorded classification and bound evidence only; no execution authentication or mathematical acceptance.

scalar.lean_parisi_target.scope: Recorded classification and bound evidence only; no execution authentication or mathematical acceptance.

scalar.lean_scalar_target.scope: Recorded classification and bound evidence only; no execution authentication or mathematical acceptance.

coverage.citation_audit_scope: Recorded documentary references only; missing effective citation IDs do not establish a mathematical or editorial verdict.
coverage.heading_syntax: ATX headings only; Setext and HTML headings are not parsed
coverage.scope: Mapped passages are correspondences, not sentence-level formal support. Section-passage overlaps are document structure, not claim or proof implications. Unmapped text and passages omitted by the selector remain in the validated paper. Graph records outside the selected prerequisite closure remain in the bundle and are not asserted absent. Argument links combine recorded Lean references, curated support, formalization correspondence and explicit assumptions; their SCCs describe only that mixed recorded reachability. Reading order and platform decomposition are separate.
